selection_policy: Published analogous-test values and supported hardware settings, not fitted to received waveforms. Actual Wandowski settings unknown.

amplifier.status: Assumed X10 setting; approximate 0.278 us delay derived from manual trend of 100 degrees lag at 1 MHz. Not measured under the experiment load; flat amplitude response and ideal voltage source remain approximations. No amplitude or time fit.

receiver.status: Assume high-impedance digitizer mode and 1 m RG58-like cable. Equipment specifications are not proof of experiment settings or cable type/length.

adhesive.status: Analogous published cyanoacrylate bond model. Wandowski specifies cyanoacrylate but does not report these properties.

remaining_unknowns: actual amplifier setting, output impedance and phase response
actual cable, digitizer termination and filtering
glue loss, bond coverage, wrap-around electrodes and solder mass
physical sensor poling and channel polarity
